slots.title: Wall Street backbone DTCC brings $30 trillion securities closer to blockchain with major banks
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: DTCC's tokenization service went live on Canton Network and private chain Besu, with JPMorgan, Citi and Morgan Stanley among 20 firms signed up.

slots.title: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola, Dell also say 'no' to OKX-ICE tokenized tock trading plan
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Nearly half the companies on the venture’s original roster have now objected to their shares trading on the planned blockchain-based venue.

slots.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.

slots.title: Meta has a new AI pet app called Waddle World
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Meta has launched a new app called Waddle World, which essentially looks like a Tamagotchi clone, but with AI.

slots.title: XRP Ledger developers propose creating wallets with zero XRP for stablecoin payments
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: An experimental change would let companies cover the reserve for customer and AI-agent accounts, allowing users to start with stablecoins without first acquiring XRP.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Amazon debuts the Alexa Photo Frame and Echo Time smart clock, plus other upgraded devices
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Amazon's other new decides include an upgraded Echo Dot, an Echo Studio with visual intelligence features, and the Echo Show 16.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
